implementation_decisions.coordinate_order: Preserve serialized live vertex and oriented-edge order. Strings and safe integral numeric node IDs are distinct. Integral float IDs normalize to safe int on direct and wire paths; bool, unsafe integer, nonintegral, nonfinite and negative-zero IDs reject.
implementation_decisions.orientation_convention: Declared coordinate choice: positive tail-to-head physical flux gives outward divergence +1 at tail, -1 at head; loops cancel. Both signs and the ordered graph bind the versioned implementation-local orientation descriptor. The frozen sources permit an orientation choice; they do not supply this implementation hash prefix.
implementation_decisions.descriptor_scope: Graph SHA-256 follows the frozen generic graph grammar. Other descriptors bind pure mathematical inputs/roles, use JCS, and are implementation-local. They do not alter the frozen schema or replace future complete stage/cache/current identities. Reconstruction supplies full graph and resolved common/candidate parameters, matrix values and retained A values; a digest alone is not a reconstructible payload.
implementation_decisions.numeric_backend: NumPy 2.4.6 is a direct pinned V4 extra. Dense binary64 Cholesky screens positive definiteness; direct solve applies paired flat. Matrix/vector products iterate declared tuple order. Exact symmetry is required. No silent symmetrization, pseudoinverse, diagonal damping, conductance floor, or resource repair.
implementation_decisions.representation_zero: Input negative zero rejects using the established V4 guards. Arithmetic zero normalizes to +0 for the existing canonical wire representation. Nonfinite output and zero/overflowed mobility factors reject.
implementation_decisions.storage: Immutable tuples and mapping proxies over privately copied dictionaries. Stable-ID lookup is O(1); retained matrices expose no mutable array alias. Empty spaces, isolates, parallel edges and loops have explicit incidence/star behavior.
implementation_decisions.covariance: GraphCoordinateAction validates complete signed bijections and endpoint preservation before applying P or U. H0 and H1 transform covariantly. Node/edge label changes and signed reorientation are fixed-space coordinate actions only.
implementation_decisions.candidate_boundary: A factor consumes supplied positive retained W_A without updating it. C factor consumes eta_C and the exact stable-edge W_C_tr map. Separate C E_H construction returns structural OneFormHodge and never grants mobility authority; complete profile/stage constructor identities remain P9-3.2/P9-4.1.
